subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(II)-34 — the section on record-company involvement, project budgets, and creative-music ensemble formations. The prose above the diagram names the structural problem: 'the dynamic implications of creative music cannot be totally achieved unless given musicians can have the opportunity to function in the composite spectrum of their activity — because duos, quartets, orchestra music, etc., can move to give an expanded realness of what is really happening in creative music.' The crossing diagrams what affinity-dynamics actually meets when it tries to be heard at the full ensemble scale: AF-DY (affinity dynamics — the music's actual vibrational working) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the receiving culture's organized listening conditions). AF-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY (information dynamics) rises above as the subject's information-output and DYM-SPT (dynamism-spectacle) hangs below with EXPM (exposure-method) at the bottom-left as the subject's downward chain. SOC-RT sits at center as partner-axis; CULT-SOLD (culture-soldered) sits at upper-right as the partner-side's preferred receiving hub, with RT-DY (reality dynamics) on the right margin and EXT-FT (extended functionalism) below RT-DY, then SCI-DYM (scientific dynamism) at the lower-right as the partner-side downward chain. DEC (decision) anchors the bottom-center as the bridging-axis terminus. Structural argument: the upper diagonal INFO-DY → CULT-SOLD → RT-DY is the *record-company route* — the music's information-dynamics gets received only through culture-soldered reality-dynamics, and from there routes through extended-functionalism into scientific-dynamism on the partner's bottom-right. The subject's DYM-SPT → EXPM downward chain is what affinity-dynamics produces *without* the upper diagonal — pure spectacle and exposure-method, the small-ensemble economics the prose describes. DEC at the bottom-center is the bridging point: only when affinity-dynamics' upper-route reaches SCI-DYM via the partner-side does the form's actual decision-content reach social-reality. Otherwise SOC-RT routes DEC back into the subject-side spectacle, and the project-budget barrier the prose names structurally repeats.
